scope: Regression deliberately reintroduced into an isolated partial checkout. The retained application selector already handles the regression.
owner_reply:
Done. Here's the full report.

Discrepancy, reproduced before the fix
- select(['sparkie/skills/desk-assistant/steps.md']) -> 2 Python tests
  (test_native_integration.py + test_energy_integration.py via the always-on
  adapters rule), compact_local_behavior=True.
- select(['sparkie/prompts/<equivalent>.md']) -> 12 Python tests
  (FLEET | ENERGY), compact_local_behavior=True.
- So the skill instruction file was selecting 10 fewer tests than the
  equivalent runtime prompt: test_fleet.py, test_collector.py,
  test_local_observation.py, test_fleet_plugs.py, test_network_links.py,
  test_energy.py, test_energy_power.py, test_energy_periods.py,
  test_energy_history.py, test_matter.py.

Cause
In tools/checks.py the generic skills/...md branch (the one my earlier
patch added the behavior flag to) only did tests.add('test_native_integration.py'),
while the branch right below it for SOUL.md/AGENTS.md/USER.md/MEMORY.md and
prompts/ does tests.update(FLEET | ENERGY). Same kind of runtime instruction,
two different test lists.

Fix (working tree, not committed)
- sparkie/tools/checks.py, one line: the generic skills/...md branch now
  does tests.update(FLEET | ENERGY) instead of
  tests.add('test_native_integration.py'). behavior stays True; the reason
  text is unchanged. test_native_integration.py was already in FLEET, so
  nothing previously selected is lost.
- sparkie/tests/test_check_selection.py, one new test
  (test_skill_instruction_files_select_the_same_python_tests_as_equivalent_prompts)
  that pins skill instruction files to the exact same python_tests list as
  equivalent prompts/ paths. All 36 pre-existing tests in that file are
  byte-identical.

Verified
- After the fix, skills/desk-assistant/steps.md and a prompts/ instruction
  both select the identical 12-test list, behavior=True on both. The same
  now holds for skills/fleet/SKILL.md and skills/fleet/steps.md.
- Neighbor regression check: I captured every plan before the edit and
  diffed after. Only the three generic-branch paths changed; the explicit
  skill branches (local-recipe-review SKILL.md/scripts: 7/6 tests,
  one-spark-serving-results SKILL.md/measure_cache.py: 7/4 tests) are
  unchanged, as are their flags.
- Ran the tool's own entry point:
  python3 tools/checks.py --paths sparkie/tools/checks.py
  sparkie/tests/test_check_selection.py --run-python
  It selected test_check_selection.py, test_preservation_selection.py plus
  the always-on test_native_integration.py and test_energy_integration.py.
- Ran the two environment-independent files directly:
  python3 -m pytest tests/test_check_selection.py
  tests/test_preservation_selection.py -> 40 passed, 0 failed (37 in
  test_check_selection.py including the new one, 3 in
  test_preservation_selection.py).

Still needs qualification
- test_native_integration.py and test_energy_integration.py (the two
  registration/adapter smoke tests the plan adds for any non-empty test
  set) did not collect in this checkout: they import sparkie_sparks and
  hermes_cli, which live in the full tree and the pinned Hermes
  environment, and this private checkout contains only sparkie/tools and
  sparkie/tests. That is a missing dependency of this workspace, not a
  regression from the change. They need a run in a compute workspace that
  has the full extension tree and the pinned Hermes environment.
- Non-Python check groups are unaffected by the edit (the flag plan for
  skill md paths is identical before and after; the fix only widens the
  python test list), but I did not re-run those browser/behavior groups
  here since the flags didn't change.
- I verified the mapping via selection() with explicit paths (the
  --paths interface). changed_paths() through git diff feeds the same
  sparkie/-prefixed paths into the same function, so the mapping is the
  same; I did not create a real tracked edit to sparkie/
  skills/desk-assistant/steps.md since this checkout has no skills/ tree.

The patch is left in the working tree of /workspace (git diff shows exactly
the two hunks above: 1 line in tools/checks.py, 1 new test in
test_check_selection.py). Nothing was committed or installed.
